title: Ulf
overview: A film about men called Ulf and their memories with other Ulf's. There are many Ulf's out there. Some of whom hardly ever get the chance to spend time with other Ulf's. Let us listen to the many voices of Ulf. And their memories with other Ulf's. Background: Ulf was the most common name in an Executive MBA class at Stockholm School of Economics, and this film was made as an interlude in a filmed quiz on economics, accounting, operations, strategy etc.
